name: mdh-odata-import-skiptoken-sync
summary: OData v4 behind an API gateway -> MDH dataset: full load windowed on the CREATION date, incremental on the LAST-CHANGE date, numeric $skiptoken paging where only an empty page ends the walk, optional $expand flatten with header-date stamping.

state_dataset.description: Data Storage collection for the single sync-state record

state_key.description: `key` of the state record, e.g. po_headers / po_line_items

id_keys.description: comma-separated natural key; composite for flattened children, e.g. PurchaseOrder,PurchaseOrderItem

created_field.description: Edm.Date field that defines the full-load scope; literals are bare ISO dates

changed_field.description: change stamp driving the incremental and the dataset watermark

order_by.description: $orderby for the full load - the ENTITY KEY, never a day-granular date

full_load_start.description: lower bound of the creation-date window; empty string skips the full load and runs incremental only

start_date.description: incremental floor when the dataset is empty and no handoff exists

expand_nav.description: navigation property to flatten (e.g. _PurchaseOrderItem); empty for a flat entity

page_top.description: $top; drop to 100-500 for an $expand feed - the gateway caps expanded pages harder and a 60s kill is close

runtime_budget_s.description: wall-clock budget per run, under the 60s serverless kill

provenance: Lifted from two production importers (purchase-order headers; purchase-order line items via header $expand) plus their account-assignment sibling, running against an SAP S/4HANA system behind an SAP BTP API gateway since 2026-01, ~2.3M line items. The behaviours encoded (skiptoken vs nextLink, empty-page termination, key ordering, creation-vs-change scoping, $select stripping the watermark, `or` forbidden) were each measured after a silent data loss or a 403. Generalized here and not yet run in this form - hence candidate. Production extras deliberately left out: parallel stateless backfill workers, key-only CSV emit for proof extracts, a raw-URL passthrough.
notes: Deletes never surface through OData GET - pair with a nightly full-replace companion (mdh-odata-filtered-full-refresh with an empty filter) if drift matters. Keep the header's date fields in any $select on an $expand URL, or the watermark is stripped. The gateway serialises beyond ~4 concurrent requests. MDH ingestion is asynchronous (HTTP 202) with one worker across datasets; a large window sits in that queue for minutes.
